text:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: ALERT: sudden spike in requests to /v1/embeddings/batch, 6x baseline RPS, 20% 429s and elevated tail latency. Cache hit rate dropped from 85% -> 22% in last 3m.
Alice (eng): paging @Mike (oncall) — looks like an automated scraper farm hitting batch embeddings.
Mike (oncall): on it, joining. can someone paste quick top UA / IP patterns?
Jen (SRE): seen repeated UA strings: "python-requests/2.28" and "curl/7.8". traffic concentrated on eu-west and ap-southeast.
Ben (infra): KV cache eviction spike around same time — likely cache churn from high fanout requests. mounting memory pressure on embedding workers.
Lu (support): customers A & C reported 429 during bulk ingestion, Ticket #3421 and #3423. severity: degraded ingest throughput.
Carol (product): any evidence of credential stuffing vs scraper behavior?
Alice (eng): looks like stateless scraping — identical small payloads hitting batch endpoint repeatedly. not valid customer patterns.
Jen (SRE): recommended mitigations in order: 1) apply dynamic quota profile to throttle high-fanout clients, 2) disable /v1/embeddings/batch for anonymous clients (keep single-item endpoints), 3) quick WAF rule to block known UA regex and abusive IP ranges.
Mike (oncall): executing cutover for dynamic quota now. will also flip batch endpoint to read-only for unknown API keys.
Mike (oncall): running command to apply quota profile:
```
curl -X POST https://control-plane.internal/api/v1/ops/quota/apply \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED_OPS_TOKEN" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"policy":"scraper-throttle-v1","match":{"ua_regex":"(python-requests|curl)" , "rate_exceed_seconds":60},"limits":{"rps":2,"burst":5}}'
```
Jen (SRE): WAF rule prepared, will push after quota policy to avoid taking down legit traffic. WAF regex: `(python-requests|curl)/(\d+\.\d+)` plus geo-block for APAC probables.
Ben (infra): temporarily scaling embedding workers down-by-30% to reduce KV churn while cache stabilizes. will revert after hit rate recovers.
IncidentBot: policy applied: scraper-throttle-v1 by Mike at ts=1745678920.
Lu (support): drafting customer banner now — short notice that bulk ingestion may see rate limits temporarily, targeted mitigation for abusive traffic.
Carol (product): quick customer impact snapshot? which orgs hit 429s vs slowed tokens?
Lu (support): Org A: 429s on batch only; Org B: slight latency but single-item ok; Org C: 429 on batch and some quota hits. we've flagged priority customers for account team.
Jen (SRE): monitoring dashboards show 50% reduction in batch RPS and 80% drop in 429s since policy applied. cache hit rate rising to 60% after 90s.
Mike (oncall): WAF rule in staging now, will promote to prod in 2m if metrics keep improving.
Alice (eng): also recommend temporary disable of large-batch ingestion for unauthenticated keys — quick toggle in feature flags: `embeddings.batch-unauth.enabled=false`.
Mike (oncall): toggled feature flag at ts=1745678935.
IncidentBot: feature flag change recorded: embeddings.batch-unauth.enabled=false by Mike.
Ben (infra): starting IP block list job for top 200 abusive IPs, will push to edge ACLs.
Lu (support): sending customer banner draft to oncall for approval:
"We are currently mitigating an automated traffic spike affecting bulk embedding requests. We have applied temporary rate limits and are blocking abusive sources. Single-item requests remain online. If you see errors, please reply with request IDs and we'll prioritize."
Mike (oncall): approve, please send.
Carol (product): capture post-incident: need better early signal for cache churn and automated policy that preemptively throttles fanout patterns.
Jen (SRE): agree — add runbook step: if cache hit rate < 40% and batch RPS > 3x baseline -> auto-apply scraper-throttle-v1.
Alice (eng): will open an RFC for automated fanout mitigation + per-key heuristics.
Mike (oncall): handing off monitoring to Jen for next 30m. if metrics degrade we rollback scaling and escalate. I'm going offline in 10m but will be reachable. :thumbsup:
Jen (SRE): taking over. will post updates every 5m.
IncidentBot: thread auto-closed for paging at ts=1745678954 (oncall handoff to Jen).
Mike (oncall): final note — keep an eye on false positives for customers using curl in CI. we'll whitelist known partner IPs quickly if flagged.
Lu (support): will watch tickets and attach banner.
Jen (SRE): monitoring now shows steady state, continuing to observe. :white_check_mark:
